name: Ukulele
description: Playing the ukulele is how I keep my creative side sharp. Learning chords, rhythm and new songs every week teaches me patience, deliberate practice, and the value of small daily reps — the same way I approach learning new tools.

name: Reading
tagline: Always one more book on the stack.
description: I read across technical books, sci-fi and essays. It's how I explore ideas I wouldn't meet at work, and it keeps me curious — plus it's quietly trained me to absorb documentation and technical content faster.

name: Rollerblading
description: Rollerblading is my physical hobby. Falling, getting back up and pushing a little further every session builds resilience and confidence — and it reminds me that progress comes from repetition and small wins, not overnight.
